description: BRANDED SWAP DOOR over our own NET pools: ask for a quote on a pair they serve and get the quote, the pool it routes through and the exact transactions for your own wallet to sign and send. It does not sign, hold, advise or promise, it takes no fee, and it is built but not switched on yet. It serves one hop with NET on one side, through four pinned pools (NET with WETH, ETH, ECO or VVV; the buying in NET's pools is the house's own), in both directions. NET also has a pool with HYDROC that this door does not serve. A quote moves its pool by at most one percent and is good for two minutes; a larger amount is refused, not split. The door asks its provider to put a minimum you receive, computed from the quote, into the transaction, but this door does not decode or verify the transaction data, so that minimum is the provider's and is not checked here: read each transaction in your own wallet before you sign it. The pools are thin, so quotes are small, and a quote is one read at one moment: the swap can fill differently, and another trader can trade ahead of you. The live quote provider, and the independent reference reader every quote is checked against, are not built yet: until both are, every quote is refused and says so. Every quote shows its fee line, and the fee is none today. The pinned NET holder disclosure comes with every quote. A swap through this door is never needed to hold NET, claim a job, vote or work. Free and keyless. You sign and send the swap yourself, from your own wallet, and pay the gas. EcoWealth created ECO, holds it and is better off if it rises. EcoWealth launched HYDROC on Hydrex's launcher, holds some and is better off if it rises. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign here; the person signs and sends the swap with their own wallet, and the house never holds a key.

amountIn.description: How much you send, a whole number in the token's smallest unit (18 decimals for these tokens), sent as a digit string. At least 1.

tokenIn.description: The token you send: NET, ECO, WETH, ETH or VVV, by symbol or 0x address. One side of the pair must be NET.

tokenOut.description: The token you receive: NET, ECO, WETH, ETH or VVV, by symbol or 0x address. One side of the pair must be NET.

wallet.description: The 0x address of your own wallet, the one that will sign and send the swap. Address only, never a private key.
